hooks.command: root="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$root" ] || root=$(unset $(git rev-parse --local-env-vars 2>/dev/null); git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.; f="$root/.agents/scripts/guard.ts"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then node "$f" turn-start; else echo '{"systemMessage":"agent-guard: this checkout has no .agents/scripts/guard.ts, so turn-start was skipped"}'; fi

root="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$root" ] || root=$(unset $(git rev-parse --local-env-vars 2>/dev/null); git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.; f="$root/.agents/scripts/guard.ts"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then node "$f" turn-end; else echo '{"systemMessage":"agent-guard: this checkout has no .agents/scripts/guard.ts, so turn-end was skipped"}'; fi
